profile_text.body:
RICHTECH ROBOTICS INC. is recorded as a public company headquartered in Las Vegas, Nevada, trading under the ticker RR, with CIK 0001963685. The website listed for it is rolls-royce.com, and the text taken from that site describes Rolls-Royce, which says it develops and delivers complex power and propulsion solutions for safety-critical applications in the air, at sea and on land, and that it has been at the forefront of innovation for more than 100 years. The site says the company's people are driven by a purpose of building a sustainably distinctive business, and that it aims to do things tomorrow that are not possible today.

The same site text reports a completed $1 Billion investment in Indiana, described as cementing Indianapolis as one of the most advanced engine manufacturing and test campuses in the world. It also reports a stated strategic intent between Reliance Industries and Rolls-Royce to partner on India's indigenous combat engine for the Advanced Medium Combat Aircraft (AMCA) programme, cooperation among Rolls-Royce, United Kingdom National Nuclear Laboratory and Japan Atomic Energy Agency on advanced nuclear technologies, and multiple contractual commitments by Rolls-Royce SMR to deliver SMR units in Europe after signing a contract with CEZ Group.

The company's recorded facts show no lawsuits, no AI products and no MCP servers listed under its name. Nevada is the jurisdiction recorded for its law exposure, with a case count of zero.
